name: fb_part_self_stave
what: an unstrung long bow stave without its string: a tall slender gently curved stave of warm orange-brown wood with clear grain, a red-brown leather grip wrapped round its middle, small horn-coloured tips with string notches, lying diagonally from the bottom left to the top right, centred with 3-5 px of padding, on its own

name: fb_part_short_stave
what: an unstrung short bow stave without its string: a short thick strongly curved stave of warm orange-brown wood, a red-brown leather grip wrapped round its middle, horn-coloured tips with string notches, lying diagonally, centred with 3-5 px of padding, on its own

name: fb_part_bowstring
what: a loose bowstring on its own: a thin pale cream twisted cord laid in a loose loop, with a small tied loop at each end, a soft brown outline so it reads on any background
